title: From the Vault: Transform: card flavor text

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A winged former guardian of the people, now considered stained with blood and no longer their protector.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A cathar apostate who declares Avacyn is no longer their guardian.

entities.name: Arguel
entities.description: A man whose vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan to a lost temple.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with jungles containing a lost temple of a bat-god.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: The lost temple of a bat-god of night in the jungles of Ixalan.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: A sun deity, eternal enemy of the bat-god of night.

entities.name: Bruna, the Fading Light
entities.description: A sister of Sigarda who now sees only Emrakul's visions.

entities.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade
entities.description: A sister of Sigarda who now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who wept upon discovering what had become of her sisters.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An entity whose visions and murmurs consume Bruna and Gisela.

entities.name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade
entities.description: A blade whose wielders soon hear a demon's call.

entities.name: Withengar Unbound
entities.description: A demon whose thirst for retribution cannot be satisfied by all the lives on Innistrad.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose lives would not satisfy Withengar's thirst for retribution.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A young mind-reader, a planeswalker, to whom people's thoughts come unbidden.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Plane named in Jace's title as Vryn's Prodigy.
